__note__: BE-C / P1-1. A real pre-2.0 backup: a pin with NO `id` (the export that produced it predates ids — applyPostSendEdits still carries a merge rule for id-less bookmarks), plus one favorite whose URL is no longer parseable. 3.1.1 refused the WHOLE file over either of those, so a user restoring their own backup got 'file format not recognised' and nothing at all. 3.1.2 imports every entry it can read, gives the id-less pin a generated `bm-` id, and reports how many entries it had to skip. exportFile is not localStorage: the test writes it to a temp path and feeds it to #ssm-import-file the way a user would.
